tabList.name: Tab List
tabList.description: Shows a status dot next to player names in the tab list.

badgeWidth.name: Badge Width
badgeWidth.description: The space reserved for the dot in front of the player name.

dotOffset.name: Dot Position
dotOffset.description: Moves the dot to the left or right.

nameTag.name: Name Tags
nameTag.description: Shows a status dot next to the name above players' heads.

dotScale.name: Dot Size
dotScale.description: Size of the dot next to the name above players' heads.

chat.name: Chat
chat.description: Shows a status dot in front of chat messages.

detectSender.name: Detect Sender by Name
detectSender.description: Finds who sent a message by their name when the server doesn't tell.

notifications.name: Notifications
notifications.description: Get notified when a friend's status changes.

pinnedOnly.name: Pinned Friends Only
pinnedOnly.description: Only notifies you about friends you pinned in LabyChat.

pinnedSound.name: Sound for Pinned Friends
pinnedSound.description: Plays a sound when a notification about a pinned friend shows up.

friendJoinedServer.name: Friend Joins Your Server
friendJoinedServer.description: Notifies you when a friend joins the server you're playing on.

showPlayersWithoutLabyMod.name: Players Without LabyMod
showPlayersWithoutLabyMod.description: Shows a dot for players who don't use LabyMod or whose status is unknown.

cycleStatusKey.name: Switch Your Status
cycleStatusKey.description: Switches your LabyChat status between Online, Away and Busy.

disabledServers.name: Disabled Servers
disabledServers.description: StatusTag hides its dots on these servers. Type a server address and press Enter, for example hypixel.net.

useLabyChat.name: LabyChat Friends
useLabyChat.description: Shows the live status of your LabyChat friends.

useLabyNetApi.name: laby.net
useLabyNetApi.description: Looks up player statuses on laby.net. Statuses that players hide stay hidden.

useMesh.name: StatusTag Sync
useMesh.description: Exchanges statuses with other players who use this addon.

statusColors.name: Status Colors
statusColors.description: Change the color of every status.

debugLogging.name: Debug Logging
debugLogging.description: Writes a log file for troubleshooting. Keep this disabled unless you need it.

clearCache.name: Clear Cache
clearCache.description: Removes all saved statuses so they get looked up again.

command.summary: %s players in the tab list, %s with a known status, %s using StatusTag, %s waiting for a lookup
command.notFound: %s is not in the tab list.

friends.none: None of your friends are online.

chat.openProfile: Click to open their laby.net profile

status_overview.name: Status Overview
status_overview.description: Shows how many players on the server are online, away, busy or offline.
status_overview.label: Statuses
